candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
Sorry, but I can't agree.

The gold in the ground is not a sovereign reserve, but private property that would have to be confiscated (which would be suicidally disruptive).

And gold mixed with rock in the ground is not at all the same thing as purified bullion in a vault.
